name: hamada-emam-tech/einvoice
description: One interface for tax-authority e-invoicing: sign every invoice and submit it. Install the core, then only the authority you need (ZATCA, Egypt ETA...). The signing key is pluggable: software key, USB token or cloud HSM.

suggest.hamada-emam-tech/einvoice-zatca: Saudi ZATCA (Fatoora): UBL 2.1, ECDSA stamp, QR, clearance and reporting
suggest.hamada-emam-tech/einvoice-eta: Egypt ETA: canonical JSON, CAdES-BES via a USB token or HSM
suggest.hamada-emam-tech/einvoice-keysource-agen: Sign with a local USB token or HSM through the Signing Agent
suggest.hamada-emam-tech/einvoice-keysource-csc: Sign remotely through a Cloud Signature Consortium (CSC) API
